title: pleopeltis alborufula
intro: Pleopeltis alborufula, commonly known as the False Waterclover, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis alborufula include antioxidant, anti-hypertensive, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
